description: This file implements a Netlink protocol handler within the WPEFramework Core namespace, providing serialization, deserialization, socket send/receive, and management of Netlink messages, primarily for Linux kernel networking extensions.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles creation, serialization, and deserialization of Netlink messages, including sequence ID management.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Provides socket-based sending and receiving of Netlink messages with thread safety and message tracking.

methods.name: Netlink::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Netlink message header and payload into a byte stream.

methods.name: Netlink::Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream into Netlink message structures, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Send
methods.description: Queues a Netlink message for sending over the socket, with optional wait for acknowledgment.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a reply, effectively performing a request-response transaction.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::SendData
methods.description: Prepares data from queued messages for socket transmission.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming socket data, dispatching it to pending message handlers or deserializing as needed.
